attack_summary: Per-programme time/cost/attrition statistics are conditioned on a programme having started and cannot see programmes suppressed by discovery-stage limits; ~85% of the druggable genome has never yielded an approved drug
required_change: Every statement that H0-a is rejected must carry, in the same paragraph, the qualifier that the rejection covers per-programme economics only and that the programme-count channel is undetermined, citing E-9536, E-9501, E-9502. The word 'rejected' must not appear unqualified.

attack_summary: Clinical efficacy failure is caused at target selection, a discovery-stage act, so attributing it to 'clinical' is an artefact of the stage at which failure is observed
required_change: Replace every instance of 'clinical attrition has dominated throughout' with the formulation distinguishing stage-of-observation from stage-of-cause, citing E-9507 and E-9506, and state that the distinction changes which intervention has elasticity.

attack_summary: Discovery was genuinely rate-limiting in antibacterials 1962-2000 and for KRAS 1982-2021, so H0-a is domain-conditional rather than globally false
required_change: The H0-a verdict must carry an explicit domain qualifier naming the two documented counter-domains (E-9503, E-9504, E-9502). Any sentence of the form 'discovery was never the bottleneck' must be deleted.

attack_summary: The genomics/target-based expansion is the best natural experiment on H0-a and output did not respond: 28 of 50 first-in-class small molecules 1999-2008 came from phenotypic screening
required_change: No change to the conclusion. Add E-9505 and E-9509 as the primary evidence for the H0-a rejection, replacing or supplementing the FDA-review-time analogy, because they test the discovery step directly.

attack_summary: H0's forward half ('clinical will become rate-limiting') restates a forty-year status quo and is not falsifiable as posed
required_change: The report must not answer H0's forward half in rank terms. It must state the falsifiable rate version (LoA 10.4%->6.7% 2014-2024 with falling termination rates, E-9512, E-9514) and name the observation that would falsify it.

attack_summary: Steelman of the case that clinical stops binding by 2040 via in-silico trials, surrogates, genetic pre-validation and relocation
required_change: No change to the conclusion. Record that the bull case was built and failed, and name the falsifier: routine acceptance of virtual control groups for pivotal efficacy in non-rare indications (E-9529, E-9530).

attack_summary: The 30-50% AI preclinical compression may be an artefact of self-chosen comparators, precedented targets and self-set clock starts
required_change: No change to the conclusion. Impose one wording constraint: the report must never state the per-programme saving in years in its own voice, because that framing exists only in company-issued material (E-9534); use the percentage on preclinical activities.

attack_summary: The low-single-digit AI IND share is a 2026 snapshot; observed doubling time of 1.2-2.1 years puts the share above 10% by 2029-2033 and 50% by 2032-2039
required_change: Every statement of the base-rate ceiling must be time-indexed to 2026 and accompanied by the doubling-time projection (E-9517, E-9518). The 2035 and 2040 bottleneck rankings must carry an explicit stated assumption about AI share, and must not assume it remains low single digit.

attack_summary: The 'no evidence AI raised PoS' verdict compares 40% against a historical 37% benchmark; the contemporaneous Citeline Phase II rate is 28%, which quadruples the apparent effect
required_change: The heading 'no evidence' must not stand over a claim about the effect. Replace with the statement that no adequately powered denominator-matched comparison exists in either direction, citing E-9537, E-9512, E-9513, and state which comparator is used at every point a benchmark success rate is quoted.

attack_summary: Capital is abundant (~USD 1.3tn deployable at top 25 pharma) and novel-target entry fell while venture funding tripled, so B11 is a price signal rather than an independent capacity constraint
required_change: Relabel B11 as 'expected terminal value' and carry it as an endogenous multiplier on other bottlenecks' elasticities rather than as a rank-3 peer, citing E-9526 and E-9509; if a single ranked list is kept, footnote that B11's elasticity is not additive with B1 and B8.

attack_summary: B1's trend is scored flat on 2011-2012 replication statistics with undisclosed selection criteria, while genetic support is a measured 2.6x lever already used in 63% of 2013-2022 approvals
required_change: Change the B1 trend cell from 'mixed to flat' to 'improving on the decision-quality channel, flat on the literature-reproducibility channel', cite E-9507 and E-9508, and bar the Amgen/Bayer statistics (E-9538) from being used as trend evidence.

attack_summary: The formulation 'discovery improved and output did not move' is invalid because a discovery-stage tool removed the PK attrition class in 1991-2000
required_change: The formulation must not appear without the Kola-Landis qualifier (E-9506) and the accompanying statement that the precedent shows discovery improvement relocates rather than relieves the constraint.

attack_summary: Candidate flow is routing to China, whose trial capacity is growing ~16%/yr with an 87-day trial clock, so US-derived saturation ceilings understate the global early-phase ceiling
required_change: Every saturation multiple and clinical-capacity ceiling must be labelled with jurisdictional scope. Add that early clinical capacity is not US-bound (E-9519, E-9520) but pivotal FDA-acceptable evidence and shared manufacturing inputs do not relocate (E-9523, E-9519), and that the global aggregate is not expanding (E-9524, E-9533). Restate the binding constraint as pivotal multiregional trial capacity.

attack_summary: B15 is ranked 5th on the biomarker qualification queue while FDA's own table lists over 200 surrogate endpoints already accepted as a basis of approval; C and E contradict each other
required_change: Move B15 from rank 5-equal to approximately rank 9-11 and add the statement that the qualification queue measures the portable channel only while the programme-specific channel is uncongested (E-9528). The report must not carry C's rank-5 justification and E's 200-endpoint finding unreconciled.

attack_summary: Raw patient-pool slack (7-8% participation, 56% no-local-trial) implies B3 is a matching problem rather than a capacity constraint
required_change: No change. Retain F's formulation that the 56% figure measures the constraint rather than slack; the independent workforce series E-9524 and E-9525 may be added as non-overlapping corroboration.

attack_summary: B2's pass-through cap is justified by zero completed NAM qualifications, a premise superseded by the December 2025 qualification and the March 2026 EMA virtual-control-group opinion
required_change: Delete the claim that zero tools have been qualified; state that one has completed FDA qualification (8 December 2025, EMA opinion March 2025), raise B2's lower-bound pass-through accordingly, and bound it by the fact that in-silico evidence remains supplemental (E-9530).

attack_summary: Delivery would have been arbitraged away by capital if it were genuinely binding
required_change: No change. Retain G's split verdict and do not collapse B7 into a single rank, because its solid-tumour and CNS halves have opposite arbitrage properties.

attack_summary: The label-noise ceiling bounds agreement with a noisy label, not model capability; apparent error rises 2.9-55x faster than true error
required_change: Split the claim: state the ceiling as a bound on measured benchmark scores and on the resolving power of the adjudicating experiment, not on capability, and carry the Scannell decision-tool result (E-9527) as the bound that actually constrains system output.

attack_summary: The B1-B16 catalogue omits clinical development design (dose, schedule, endpoint, population), a measurable sponsor-controllable P-axis failure mode
required_change: Add B17 'clinical development design: dose, schedule, endpoint and population selection' as a distinct entry with axes P and C, anchored on E-9531 and E-9515, with a stated rank; and state explicitly that it was surfaced by the red team and absent from B1-B16.

attack_summary: The 'regulation is a net reliever' count covers authorisation instruments only; pricing regulation has a measured negative effect on US trial starts
required_change: Scope the net-reliever conclusion to marketing- and trial-authorisation instruments at every point it appears, and add the IRA interrupted time-series result of -11.4 trials plus -1.2/month (E-9525) as the countervailing pricing-regulation effect.
